title: rosa foetida var. bicolor
intro: Rosa foetida var. bicolor, commonly known as the Indian Clove or Pink Indian Rose, is a shrub-like plant species native to the Himalayas and other parts of Asia. It is a member of the rose family (Rosaceae) and is known for its vibrant pink and yellow flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate stress, anxiety, and other health issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and provide relief from various health conditions.
